beats.say: Larne face Linfield today with Gary Haveron managing the home side.
According to the BBC, David Healy manages the away team Linfield.
Larne sit in 3rd place with 20 points in the league table.
Linfield currently hold 2nd place with 27 points.
The BBC reports that Steven Gregg is the referee for the match.
Will Larne close the gap on Linfield today?
